row.title: A model-authored change replaced actions-budget.json and turned main red
row.body: Executor commit 54d6e57e7 (Q-ULTRA-free-tier-meter-spend-REDESIGN) overwrote the workflow kill-switch config with an unrelated document; test_lint_workflows, test_launch and silentfail then raised KeyError on every PR. Restored from 22e4d4800; the executor now refuses a change that drops top-level keys of an existing JSON object (SCHEMA-KEEP-1); tests pass.
